Trace, implement and test: longest prefix and suffix conditions are both are equal and not overlapped

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
# longest prefix and suffix conditions are both are equal and not overlapped
# print the length of suffix or prefix

# Test Case 
# abcdabc
# output : 3

# Test Case 
# ababa
# output : 2


input = input()
length = len(input)

mid = length // 2

for i in range(mid, 0, -1):
    prefix = input[:i]
    suffix = input[length-i:]
    if prefix == suffix:
        print(len(prefix))
        break
